stem: Methylpropane, $(\text{CH}_3)_2\text{CHCH}_3$, is an isomer of butane, $\text{CH}_3(\text{CH}_2)_2\text{CH}_3$.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: Explain why methylpropane and butane are a pair of isomers.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Identify the type of isomerism shown by methylpropane and butane.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
When a sample of butane is heated to $373\text{ K}$, in the presence of a catalyst, and allowed to reach equilibrium the following reaction occurs.

$$\text{CH}_3(\text{CH}_2)_2\text{CH}_3(\text{g}) \rightleftharpoons (\text{CH}_3)_2\text{CHCH}_3(\text{g}) \quad \Delta H = -8.0\text{ kJ mol}^{-1}$$

State and explain the effect on the composition of this equilibrium mixture when the temperature is increased to $473\text{ K}$.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
1 mole of butane gas was added to a $1\text{ dm}^3$ closed system, at a constant temperature and pressure. The amount of butane and methylpropane was measured at regular time intervals.



{{figure:visual_auto_01.png}}

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text: Label the graph with a $t$ to show the time taken to reach dynamic equilibrium.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Use the graph to find the concentration of butane and methylpropane in the mixture at equilibrium.

parts.label: (c)(iii)
parts.text: Write an expression for $K_{\text{c}}$ for this reaction.

parts.label: (c)(iv)
parts.text: Calculate a value for $K_{\text{c}}$ and state its units.
